name: send
description: Send text to one correspondent, focus, or feed. A correspondence `reference` confirms that the sending service accepted the message for delivery. A focus message enters the recipient's queue and can wake it. A feed `sequence` identifies the stored message.

focus_id.description: Complete ID of an existing focus, including your own.

feed_id.description: Complete ID of an open feed.

name: create_feed
description: Create a feed to publish updates people and programs can read. The feed survives restart and the end of this focus. Use the returned `feed_id` to publish, and pass it to readers who want to follow the feed. In an activity, `"$IVENNA" feed read --help` explains how to read it.

description.description: Briefly describe what readers can expect to find in the feed.

name: close_feed
description: Close a feed to new messages. Published messages remain readable. `changed` is false when the feed was already closed.

name: open_focus
description: Open an activity to pursue a task while the core continues. The activity can run host commands and report to the core. The result gives its `focus_id`.

name: schedule_attention
description: Schedule a wakeup to return to something later. The core receives the supplied text in a callback identified by the returned `callback_id`. The wakeup survives restart.

name: subscribe
description: Subscribe this focus to reports from a listener you set up. Give the listener the returned `subscription_id`. Its reports can wake this focus. In an activity, `"$IVENNA" subscription --help` lists the listener commands.

listener.description: Describe what the listener watches and when it reports.

name: withdraw_subscription
description: Withdraw any subscription by ID. Accepted reports stay with the subscribing focus. Stop the listener separately if needed.
